title: Retrieve deferred freight quote total
workflow_definition:
  parameters: []
  blocks:
    - block_type: code
      label: calculate_and_extract_quote_total
      prompt: Open quote QF-4821, calculate its shipping-inclusive order total, and return the page-displayed total as a number.
      code: |
        await page.goto("http://localhost:8900/deferred_total_quote/")
        quote_heading = page.get_by_text("Quote QF-4821", exact=True)
        await quote_heading.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        total_panel = page.locator("div.totals")
        await total_panel.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        await page.locator("#calculate-total").click()
        await total_panel.locator("strong").wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        total_text = (await total_panel.locator("strong").inner_text()).strip()
        normalized_total = total_text.replace("$", "").replace(",", "").strip()
        order_total = float(normalized_total)
        return {
          "quote_id": "QF-4821",
          "order_total": order_total,
          "displayed_total": total_text,
          "evidence_text": (await total_panel.inner_text()).strip()
        }
